statement: xwiimote opens kernel Wii evdev children including MotionPlus, with no direct Wii register commands. Status edges reach xwiimote only through hid-wiimote reconciliation and updated nodes; without a new edge xwiimote continues existing interfaces. A generic binding without Wii kernel children does not gain xwiimote motion from synthetic status.

applicability.revision: Original external MotionPlus and integrated Remote Plus distinguished where possible; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. lib/core.c 335-393,611-672,1045-1090 and kernel hotplug 1095-1224. Source-only; all physical and proposed host experiments not run.
